text:
Maya Thompson: FYI we27re seeing intermittent auth failures for onboarding webhooks and SSO flows for a small set of tenants. Several new customers have stalled activation; 3 of them are on renewal watch. Need a crisp customer note + playbook for AEs.

Connor Lee: Root cause? Is this a token rotation or an upstream identity provider issue?

Maya Thompson: Initial signal points to a bad edge cache of rotated tokens in the onboarding proxy after yesterday27s cert refresh. Engineers are reverting the proxy cache behavior to immediate-refresh mode. ETA full recovery ~60-75 minutes.

Priya Nair: From CS ops: recommended comms (1) quick proactive alert to affected accounts, (2) personalized outreach to renewal-risk customers with offer for activation assistance and scheduling, (3) one complimentary onboarding review session for those impacted.

Omar Haddad: Agree. For public-facing message keep it short and operational; for renewal cohort include next steps, credit line, and invite to a 30m technical review.

Jules Martin (Legal): Credit phrasing approved: "We will evaluate eligibility for service or goodwill credits consistent with your contract; our team will follow up to confirm." Avoid financial specifics in the first message.

Maya Thompson: Draft message for affected tenants below 27short form27. Comments?

```
Hi [Customer],

We detected intermittent authentication failures affecting onboarding webhooks and SSO connections for some accounts. Our engineers identified a cache handling issue introduced during a certificate refresh and are deploying a rollback now. We expect full activation traffic to return to normal in ~60-75 minutes.

What we27re doing:
- Reverting the proxy cache refresh behavior to ensure tokens are accepted immediately.
- Monitoring stalled activations and prioritizing any backfill or manual activation requests.
- Offering a complimentary onboarding review session for affected customers.

Next steps: Your CS lead will follow up with an update once service is restored and to schedule any assistance or review. We will also evaluate eligibility for credits and confirm any offer in that follow-up.

You can follow the incident at <status.redwood.ai/inc/INC-2026-901>.

Sorry for the inconvenience and thanks for your patience.

2D Maya, Customer Success
```

Connor Lee: LGTM. For the renewal-touch accounts add: "If you27d like immediate help, reply with preferred times and we27ll schedule a dedicated session within 24 hours."

Priya Nair: I27ll prepare an AE one-pager with impacted tenants, suggested credit wording, and a short script for scheduling calls. Also will add a CS tracker column (accepted assistance, requested credits, risk flag update).

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-901 (priority: high). Postmortem scheduled tomorrow 11:00 AM PT.

Omar Haddad: Can AEs own the renewal cohort outreach? Connor, Priya 2D can you coordinate calendar blocks?

Connor Lee: Yes, I27ll coordinate and block 3 x 30m slots tomorrow for the renewal cohort.

Maya Thompson: Thanks all. Sending the short note to affected tenants after Jules confirms the legal line. :white_check_mark:
